contract: POST /api/me/ereader-devices replaces the caller's single-user ereader devices in the email-settings row while keeping devices of other users, requires name/email, availabilityOption "specificUsers" and only the caller in users, rejects duplicate names across all stored devices with 400, answers 200 with the caller's accessible devices and emits ereader-devices-updated to the caller when the row changed.
exceptions: force is not applicable: this route has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: A valid device list answers 200 with exactly the caller's submitted devices, persists them in the email-settings row (creating the row with its defaults) and the caller's login payload serves the same accessible devices; an empty array removes every device of the caller and is valid.

Writing devices replaces only the caller's single-user specificUsers devices: other users' devices stay in the stored row and are never returned to the caller, and re-sending the stored list leaves the row and the response unchanged.

POST /api/me/ereader-devices answers 400 for a missing or non-array ereaderDevices, an item without name or email, an availabilityOption other than specificUsers, and a users list that is not exactly the caller, and 400 for a name already used by any stored device; rejected requests leave the settings row unchanged.
